description: This file defines a custom ILoggerProvider implementation for use with xUnit testing framework, providing logging capabilities that output to test output helpers.

classes.name: XunitLoggerProvider
classes.description: Implements ILoggerProvider to create loggers that output to xUnit test output.

classes.name: XunitLogger
classes.description: Implements ILogger and IDisposable to log messages to the xUnit test output helper.

methods.name: XunitLoggerProvider
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the provider with an ITestOutputHelper.

methods.name: CreateLogger
methods.description: Creates an instance of XunitLogger for a given category name.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the logger provider (no specific implementation).

methods.name: XunitLogger
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the logger with an output helper and category.

methods.name: BeginScope
methods.description: Begins a logical operation scope (returns the logger itself).

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the logger (no specific implementation).

methods.name: IsEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a given log level is enabled (always returns true).

methods.name: Log
methods.description: Logs a message to the test output helper with formatted log level, category, event ID, and message.
